No measure: the per-agent TB2.0/TB2.1 scores are given only in figures (Fig. 4 scatter, Fig. 5 curves, Fig. 6 bars: SVG without value labels; the numbers of the text sit in lost math tags), so no value is citable and the research file held no row. Recensed with the configurations of the OpenAI runs (Table 4 route, Table 6 effort overrides) as note facts. The equivalent numbers for GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.6 are in the harbor-framework submissions (source src-github-harbor-framework-terminal-bench-2-1-submissions-2026-11-09); the paper's GPT 5.3 Codex / 5.4 / 5.4 mini runs are not there. The project site (ekbuchanan.com/terminal-bench-2-1-paper/) returned a 404 page. Figures not digitised.
